title: Monotonicity of the Window Bound
statement: Let $N$ be a finite nondeterministic Turing machine over the binary alphabet, let $x$ and $w$ be binary strings, and let $s\le s'$ be natural numbers. If every configuration reached from the initial configuration of $N$ on $x$ by following any prefix of $w$ lies in the window of radius $s$, then every such configuration lies in the window of radius $s'$ as well.
hypotheses_covered: N is a finite nondeterministic Turing machine over the binary alphabet.
x and w are binary strings.
s and s' are natural numbers with s ≤ s'.
For every prefix length j from 0 through |w|, the configuration after the first j choice bits of w lies in the radius-s window.
